title: Powerful Features, Limited Ease of Use
body: Apple Notes has potential, but it still feels limited and less intuitive than it should be. While Apple continues to add features, the overall experience remains basic and sometimes cumbersome. Better organization, formatting tools, and usability improvements would make a significant difference.
